questions.stem: A spinner has $P(\text{red}) = 0.35$. If spun $400$ times, how many times is it expected to land on red?
An expected outcome calculation gives $37.5$. What does this mean in practice?

options.text: The event will happen exactly $37.5$ times
The event will happen either $37$ or $38$ times
On average, you would expect the event about $37$ or $38$ times; the actual number will vary
The calculation must be wrong because you cannot have half an outcome

questions.explanation: Expected outcomes give a theoretical average. In practice, the actual count will vary each time the experiment is carried out, but over many repetitions the average will be close to $37.5$.
